research_statement.objective: Benchmark resilience rituals for hybrid cloud data platforms

key_questions.question: Which rituals correlate with shorter rollback windows?
key_questions.answer: Playbook dry-runs every 30 days plus joint pager reviews lead to 28% faster rollback.

key_questions.question: How do high-performing teams staff incident commanders?
key_questions.answer: They rotate staff weekly and pair senior ICs with apprentice coordinators.

key_insights: Runbook dry-runs and failure injection keep rollback muscle-memory fresh.
Incident commanders with buddy system reduce fatigue and knowledge loss.
Capacity planning rituals tied to customer impact metrics outperform infra-only approaches.
surprising_findings: Teams with customer-facing SLIs surfaced rollback success metrics faster than infra-only orgs.
recommendations: Link capacity planning with product metrics

evidence.summary: Monthly runbook dry-runs cut rollback windows by 28% across 11 teams.
Buddy system for ICs reduces fatigue and knowledge loss while keeping MTTR steady.
Capacity planning rituals tied to customer SLIs reduce surprise incidents by 22%.
